cards.title: demos/louis-agent/config
cards.text: The coding agent's own settings, which its stack and its launch profiles point at.

cards.title: Its files
cards.text: .env and .env.secrets from their examples, the LLM profiles, prices, rates, Rider's entries.

cards.title: A first run
cards.text: Copy the two examples, point REPOSITORIES_PATH at your repos, compose up the api.

cards.title: Debugging in Rider
cards.text: The api profile on 5081 and mcp-http on 5091 set what the stack sets.

cards.title: Settings only it reads
cards.text: REPOSITORIES_PATH and API_PORT (5082) for the stack; ORCHESTRATOR_* for a run by hand.
